name: WALL MOUNT- 11 PLATE - ZEROB HYDROLIFE
summary: The ZeroB Alkaline RO Water Purifier is a high-performance water purification system designed to deliver safe, healthy, and alkaline drinking water.
intro: The ZeroB Alkaline RO Water Purifier combines advanced RO purification, alkaline ionization, and ESS (Electrolytic System Sanitizer) technology to ensure pure, mineral-rich, and healthy drinking water. Equipped with an 11-plate platinized titanium electrode ionizer, the purifier can produce water with varying pH levels suitable for drinking, cooking, hydrogen water, and sanitizing purposes. Its 10 litres per hour purification capacity and 8-litre storage tank ensure a continuous supply of purified water for homes and small offices. The purifier features a 3.8-inch Smart Colour LCD display for easy monitoring and operation.
features: Suitable for water with TDS up to 1500 ppm
Delivers healthy, mineral-rich, and great-tasting drinking water
